body:
Filed on behalf of gary/codex for real upstream work merged via PR garyredg/codex/fix-failing-tests (commit 75ad04a, merged through d5ade80/8158abf). Fix: packages/simulation/parena_runtime.h unconditionally #included <SDL2/SDL.h> and <SDL2/SDL_ttf.h> even though most PARENA-generated mods (including the editor_mod_test target) never call any SDL function -- gated those headers and all SDL2 host-glue behind a new opt-in macro, PARENA_RUNTIME_ENABLE_SDL2, defined by nothing in this repo's current build graph. This is the real, confirmed root cause of the CI failure this session spent two rounds investigating (Apples #17235/#17236, EMILY BACKLOG SECTION 237/S203-04): editor_mod_test.c (a real Bazel test target under //packages/simulation) transitively required libsdl2-dev/libsdl2-ttf-dev dev headers just to compile, which a bare ubuntu-latest CI runner's 'test' job never installs (only the separate, test-gated build_linux job does) -- while this dev box already has both packages installed, which is exactly why three separate local cold-cache repro attempts never caught it. Verified live, not just by commit message: CI runs 33683787996 (d5ade806) and 33684071625 (8158abf, the final merge) both completed with every job green -- Bazel Test, both platform builds, and the release job. Rebased local PAPERCRAFT main onto origin/main (fast-forward, no conflicts) to pick this up. No local code changes needed this pass -- this Apple documents and credits the real upstream fix.

⚓ ☃
title: Upstream fix (gary/codex): SDL2 runtime headers made opt-in, fixes the real Bazel Test CI failure
